description: This file contains utility methods for testing engine-related components in the Rusefi project, including assertions, logging, and chart data retrieval.

classes.name: TestingUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing testing and verification methods for engine chart data and waveforms.

methods.name: assertTrue
methods.description: Asserts that a boolean condition is true; throws an exception and logs if false.

methods.name: assertCloseEnough
methods.description: Checks if a current value is within an acceptable ratio of expected values.

methods.name: printRange
methods.description: Returns a string representing the acceptable range around a current value based on a ratio.

methods.name: fixAngle
methods.description: Normalizes an angle to within a 720-degree cycle.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs a failure message and throws an IllegalStateException.

methods.name: assertWave
methods.description: Asserts that a waveform matches expected parameters within tolerances.

methods.name: nextChart
methods.description: Retrieves the next chart data, parsing it into an EngineChart object.

methods.name: getNextWaveChart
methods.description: Requests and retrieves the next wave chart string from the engine.

methods.name: getEngineChart
methods.description: Blocks until the next engine chart data is available and returns it as a string.
